# China Tea Group

> China Tea Group is a Chinese green tea export company based in Zhejiang Province, China, with a trading office in Hong Kong. It selects, blends, packs and ships Chunmee and Gunpowder green tea for importers, wholesalers, packers and retail chains in the Maghreb, West Africa and Europe, under its own brands (Al Mousafir, Dkhmiss, Amghar, 511) or as private label (OEM). The website is available in French, English and Spanish.

## Key facts

- Activity: export of Chinese green tea (Chunmee and Gunpowder), private label (OEM) packing, export logistics
- Tea grades: Chunmee 41022, Chunmee 4011 Extra, Chunmee 9371, Gunpowder 3505
- House brands (9): Chunmee: Dkhmiss (41022 5A, Sahraoui and Diwan lines; 9371 wooden crate), Amghar (41022, Amazigh/Berber design), Al Mousafir (4011), 4111 (4011), 401 (4011, ATAY box), 711 (green cube, in 4011 or 3505), 9371 (9371, Dkhmiss wooden-crate box). Gunpowder: 511 (3505 Diamant Special Edition, black and golden-yellow box), 777 (3505 AAAAA, green-and-gold box)
- Also supplies: 100% pure honey (Assila, Mill Miel, Luna Honey); canned goods (Rollio double tomato concentrate in 1/6 (135 g), 1/2 (400 g) and 4/4 (800 g) cans, Bondélice double tomato concentrate in 1/2 (400 g) and 4/4 cans, Bondélice sweet corn and garden peas in 3 × 130 g packs, Mama délice sweet corn and garden peas); Mamafé peanut paste in 500 g and 1 kg jars; custom luggage bags printed with the customer’s brand (sizes M, L, XL)
- Markets served: Morocco and the Maghreb, the Sahel and West Africa, Europe (ethnic grocers and diaspora)
- Services: lot selection and blending, private label (OEM) packaging, quality control with pre-shipment samples, 20FT and 40FT container export (FOB, CFR, CIF)
- Head office: 7th floor, Tower A, 88 Financial Business Street, Zhongfu Plaza, Zhejiang Province, China
- Trading office: Room 701, Tower B, New Mandarin Plaza, Tsim Sha Tsui, Kowloon, Hong Kong
- Phone / WhatsApp: +86 180 5797 8014
- Languages: French, English, Spanish

## Teas

- [Chinese green teas, grade by grade](https://www.chinateagroup.com/en/teas/): comparison of all grades
- [Chunmee 41022](https://www.chinateagroup.com/en/teas/chunmee-41022/): long twisted leaf, yellow-green liquor, the classic for mint tea
- [Chunmee 4011 Extra](https://www.chinateagroup.com/en/teas/chunmee-4011/): finer, more even leaf, smooth and fragrant cup
- [Chunmee 9371](https://www.chinateagroup.com/en/teas/chunmee-9371/): medium rolled leaf, strong amber cup for daily drinking
- [Gunpowder 3505](https://www.chinateagroup.com/en/teas/gunpowder-3505/): tightly rolled pearls that hold several infusions
